text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan gomɗimɓe ɓen: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe, ñinniree julde nden no timmiri, nafqon e ɗin waɗɗiiɗi e yiɗaaɗi ɗi Alla arsiki on, waɗiron ɗum gunndoo rentorgol e yiingo, feññiniron ɗum no woɗɓe ñemmbira on, ado nde arata on ñalaande nde ngyeygu alaa e mun wanaa sootorɗum e lepte Alla ɗen, wanaa kadi weldigal nafirayngal tefangol weldiiɗo mun.
